text.description_html:
Bommer 7813HD, Heavy Duty Floor Spring Hinge Set

Horizontal type double action floor spring hinge set includes top pivot, side plates, back plate, and wood screws. Double action spring hinges are typically used on restaurant doors or bar doors that open in both directions and require self closing. Includes 7890-603 top pivot and side trim plates. Available in 8 different finishes. Made in the USA.

This floor spring hinge is for use on 1-3/8" to 1-3/4" thick doors up to 150 pounds. Adjustable tension spring allow you to determine how much closing force you apply to the door (how hard/fast the door self closes). Includes adjustment tool.

Specifications: for Bommer 7813HD Horizontal Spring Hinge Set

  • Spring Hinge: 9-1/4" Long
  • Cover Plate Length: 9-3/4"
  • Cover Plate Height: 2-5/8"
  • Door Weight: 150 Lbs. Maximum
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/8" to 1-3/4" Thick Doors
  • Door Width: 42" Maximum
  • Heavy Duty Ball Bearing Hinge
  • Double-acting (swings in both directions)
  • Non-Hold Open
  • Non-handed
  • Adjustable Spring Tension
  • Bommer 7813HD Dimensional Diagram (PDF)

Sold as a Set (Enough to do one door).



** This item is Discontinued. See available Double Swing Door Hinges.
